welcome:
🦅 *Welcome to News Eagle Live*
_Stay Ahead, Stay Informed_

Let's set you up in 30 seconds.
onboarding_categories:
📌 *Pick the categories you care about.*
Tap to toggle. Tap *Done* when finished.
onboarding_pincode:
📍 *Set your PIN code* for local news, weather, and alerts.

Send your 6-digit Indian PIN code, or tap *Skip*.
onboarding_done:
🎉 *You're all set!*

Try /news or /latest to start. Use /help to see all commands.
help:
*Commands*

/news — browse by category
/latest — latest headlines
/breaking — breaking news
/trending — trending stories
/categories — manage your interests
/search — search news
/localnews — local news (PIN code)
/setpincode — set your PIN code
/alerts — keyword alerts
/bookmarks — saved articles
/history — reading history
/digest — today's digest
/quiz — current-affairs quiz
/chat — ask the AI
/settings — preferences
/language — change language
no_pincode: 📍 You haven't set a PIN code yet. Use /setpincode to add one.
pincode_invalid: ❌ Invalid PIN code. Send a 6-digit Indian PIN.
pincode_not_found: ❌ Couldn't find that PIN code. Please double-check and try again.
no_news: 📭 No news right now — try again in a few minutes.
rate_limited: ⏱️ You're going too fast. Try again in a minute.
ai_unavailable: 🤖 The AI assistant is briefly unavailable. Please try again shortly.
keyword_add_prompt: 🔔 Send the keyword you'd like to be alerted about (e.g. *Bitcoin*, *NVIDIA*, *IPL*).
keywords_empty: 🔔 No keyword alerts yet. Add one with /alerts.
quiz_intro: 🧠 *Current-Affairs Quiz* — answer {n} questions. Tap an option.
